skills.name: Sunstrike Tide Range
skills.description: Deals DMG equal to 500% of ATK to enemies in a dense area within a 3-meter radius. DMG to enemies with HP below 50% increases by 30%.

upgrades.level2: Increases CRIT DMG by 50% when triggering CRIT.
upgrades.level4: DMG to enemies with HP below 50% increases by 50%.

skills.name: Wave-Chasing Slash
skills.description: Swims through enemies 4 times consecutively. The first 3 times deal DMG equal to 120%, 150%, and 180% of ATK. The final hit deals DMG equal to 250% of ATK and knocks down enemies that are hit.

upgrades.level2: Increases DMG to 130%, 160%, 190%, and 270% of ATK.
upgrades.level3: Each full cast increases ATK by 25% for 6s.
upgrades.level4: Increases DMG to 140%, 170%, 200%, and 300% of ATK.

skills.name: Wavecrest Blade
skills.description: Passive: Each time Wave-Chasing Slash deals DMG, gains 1 stack of Overlapping Waves. Each stack of Overlapping Waves increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 10s.

upgrades.level2: Each stack of Overlapping Waves increases CRIT Rate by 8%.
upgrades.level4: Each stack of Overlapping Waves increases CRIT Rate by 10%.

skills.name: Breath of the Water Mirror
skills.description: Passive: Hebo takes 40% less DMG while swimming during Wave-Chasing Slash. This effect increases by 5% every 2s, and remains for 3s after Wave-Chasing Slash ends.

upgrades.level2: Takes 60% less DMG while swimming during Wave-Chasing Slash.
upgrades.level3: Gains a Shield equal to 400% of ATK after fully casting Wave-Chasing Slash.
upgrades.level4: Increases the DMG taken reduction effect by 7% every 2s.

relic.name: Tides of Origin
relic.description: Each full cast of Wave-Chasing Slash grants 200 Energy.

upgrades.level2: Each full cast of Wave-Chasing Slash permanently increases Hebo's ATK by 25%, up to 3 stacks.
upgrades.level3: Each full cast of Wave-Chasing Slash grants 300 Energy.
upgrades.level4: Each full cast of Wave-Chasing Slash permanently increases Hebo's ATK by 40%, up to 3 stacks.
